work: Created a standalone page for the fixed rotating boat lift and its separately ticketed boat excursion. Verified Scottish Canals current official page, location, winter visitor-centre hours, minimum excursion fares and accessibility; searched official Park and StandaloneAttraction catalogues; imported two exact September 2026 CC BY-SA 2.0 photographs; verified eight public pages and both image binaries; published Facebook.
qualification: The boat lift is a permanent, separately ticketed transport experience at a multi-activity canal site, not a ride inside an admission-gated amusement park. The entry represents the wheel and its original boat trip, not adjacent paddleboarding or mini-golf.

visitorInformation.pricingDecision: Operator lists adult boat trip from GBP 14.63 and child aged 5–15 from GBP 7.84 on 2026-11-14; recorded as dynamic minimum prices, not fixed fares. Under-five and registered-carer tickets are free but still required, explained in notes.
visitorInformation.hoursDecision: Operator lists visitor-centre hours Wednesday–Sunday 09:45–15:30 from 1 November 2026. Boat departures use a booking calendar; no unconditional ride hours entered.
visitorInformation.accessibility: Wheelchair or mobility scooter can board the boat; mention it at booking so capacity can be adjusted.
visitorInformation.tripDuration: Approximately one hour, dependent on waterway traffic.
